# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P20](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P55](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0055), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P70](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0070), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P39](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Pettifer is a short, heavy-set, and bald man with a round face. When enraged, his circular countenance turns violet while his bulging azure eyes nearly protrude from his head.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011)_

## Personality

Pettifer describes himself as a candid man prone to impetuousness and stating what is real. Though observed to resent being pitied, he is considered pleasant, with his pleasantness doubling after his remarriage despite a perceived bias against matrimony.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009)_

## History

Before coming to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Pettifer lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). As a schoolboy, he was routinely flogged by his master on the assumption that he was planning trouble even if not actively causing it. Pettifer angrily confronted [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) when her cow escaped into his oat field. Shortly after, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mistakenly sold Pettifer's Jersey cow to a third party; when she confessed her error and offered her own cow in trade, he reacted generously, accepted the exchange, and invited her for tea. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later engaged him in conversation about her plans for managing her school through affection, and on another occasion, he turned down her request for a donation to her cause. During a severe storm, lightning struck Pettifer's home and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), which had been given to him by his seafaring brother. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visited to offer him comfort following the tragedy, during which Pettifer opened up about the history of his marriage, his past quarrel over the parrot, and his ultimate reconciliation with his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), +28 more_

## Quotes

> "Apologies, young lady! Expressing regret will not fix what happened. You ought to walk over and view the destruction that creature caused among my oats . . . crushed them completely from the middle to the edges, young lady."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> "He . . . he utters foolishness constantly. My brother, a seafaring man, gave him to me. A sailor's speech isn't always particularly refined, and birds like parrots copy things easily."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)

> “Who? Mrs. Sowerby? Do not tell me that I resemble that ancient chatterbox,” Mr. Pettifer said in an annoyed manner. “I am not . . . not in the least. What is inside that box?”
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I do not, indeed, and I am extremely pleased with it, as well. You have my gratitude. The surface appears nice. My expectation is that it remains just as nice underneath."
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Listen to my suggestion, young lady, you need to assist me in consuming it. After I set the kettle to boil, a cup of tea will be enjoyed by both of us. Is that acceptable to you?"
>
> — Pettifer — [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

## Relationships

### Henry

Pettifer and Henry act as comrades, having served as traveling companions on their journey to town.

- Comrade of — traveling companions to town  <sub>[v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P25](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0025)</sub>

### [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-henry-carter--pettifer.md)

Pettifer employs [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) as a hired helper and worker. Carter assists with Pettifer's affairs, such as delivering news to neighbors after a severe storm struck Pettifer's house and killed his pet parrot.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), +2 more_

- Commands — employed as a hired helper or worker  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--pettifer.md)

Pettifer and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are neighbors who frequently visit and talk, despite an initial rough patch when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally sold Pettifer's Jersey cow and had to confess her mistake. Pettifer received her offer gracefully and accepted a replacement cow, initiating a friendly rapport where they regularly converse about school discipline, local gossip, and the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) also calls on him to offer comfort after a severe storm kills his pet parrot, though Pettifer previously declined her request for a donation.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), +23 more_

- Friend of — neighbors who share visits and conversations  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pettifer--robin-farrow.md)

Pettifer maintains a friendly relationship with [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), who admires him and assists him with hauling dulse. However, their connection faces occasional friction when [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) misbehaves, such as the incident where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) locked young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) inside Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), +2 more_

- Friend of — assisting him with hauling dulse and admiring him  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)</sub>
